title: KrishiMitra Historical District Reconciliation Crosswalk
standards_used: Local Government Directory (LGD) - Ministry of Panchayati Raj, GoI

Uttar Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2000 (Act No. 29 of 2000)

crosswalk.administrative_reason: Homonymous district collision. Bilaspur is a legitimate district of Himachal Pradesh. It was clobbered in the legacy profile merge by Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh due to state-unaware District_Name keying.
crosswalk.source_authority: LGD India Code 17; Census of India 2011 HP District Handbook; Bilaspur District Administration
crosswalk.reconciliation_action: For multi-district profile builds: ensure join key includes BOTH State_Name and District_Name. Append missing geographical coordinates and administrative codes to reference geography layer.
